description:
“You need the money, and I have plenty of it… Don’t you think it’s a fair trade?”

“Tae-i Kwon” is a young youth suffering under a mountain of debt. No matter how hard he works, it seems the debt only keeps growing. Driven into a corner, he gets a high-paying job at a gay bar, and it is here he meets the CEO of the place, Odo Seo. Odo, who is being stalked by a mysterious pursuer, suggests a contractual fake relationship with Tae-i. What starts out as a quick stint to earn money for Tae-i becomes complex when he starts to fall in love with the ever sensual Odo Seo. But the closer he gets to Odo, the closer the dangers surrounding Odo approach to suffocate Tae-i. When the identity of Odo’s stalker slowly starts to unveil and Odo’s true intentions come to light, how will it shake Tae-i’s life around?

(Source: Copin Comics)
